## LIQUIBASE VERSIONING MODEL (MUST MATCH YOUR AGREED DATABASE MIGRATION STANDARD)

- DDL changesets: schema-[entity]-[version]
- DML changesets: data-[entity]-[version]
- Immutability: executed changesets MUST NOT be modified; create a new [version] instead
- DML rules: DML MUST use custom Java classes extending CustomDataTaskChange (no raw SQL DML)

---

## DATA MODEL STANDARDS

### Primary Key Requirement

- EVERY table MUST have a primary key column named: id
- The id must:
  - Be unique
  - Be non-null
  - Be the primary identifier of the record

### ID Type

- The id must use a consistent type across the system:
  - UUID (preferred) OR
  - Long (auto-increment)

- Mixing ID types across tables is NOT allowed

### Base Entity Requirement

- All entities MUST inherit from a base entity that includes:
  - id
  - tenant_id
  - created_at
  - updated_at

### Constraints

- No table may exist without an id column
- Composite primary keys are NOT allowed unless explicitly approved
